<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Cabinet approvals:</strong> The Union Cabinet approved the ₹84,084-crore &#x27;Samudra Manthan&#x27; offshore exploration scheme and an expansion of the Khelo India Scheme with a ₹36,441-crore outlay.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial and administrative matters:</strong> CAPF officers moved the Supreme Court to challenge new promotion rules, while the government informed the court that nationality verification is mandatory before the deportation of foreign nationals.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google._?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Electoral and political developments:</strong> The Election Commission of India concluded a national round table conference and extended the SIR schedule, while a Bihar BJP MLC resigned to accommodate a minister, complying with Supreme Court observations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google._?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
</ul>
